# GFM Formatting Showcase

This showcase demonstrates comprehensive GitHub Flavored Markdown inline styling and block elements rendered by md2png.

## Inline Typography and Strikethrough
Text can be styled with *standard italic emphasis*, **strong bold text**, and ***combined bold italic typography*** seamlessly.
We also support ~~strikethrough text that can easily wrap across multiple lines in long paragraphs to ensure that horizontal strike rules are continuously and proportionally rendered without clipping~~ throughout regular running copy.

## Task Lists
- [x] Completed task item with geometric checkmark
- [ ] Incomplete pending task box cleanly aligned
- [x] Nested task item inside list
  - [x] Sub-task one (done)
  - [ ] Sub-task two (todo)

## Tables and Blockquotes
| Feature | Syntax | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Italic | `*italic*` | *Supported* |
| Bold Italic | `***bold italic***` | ***Supported*** |
| Strikethrough | `~~strike~~` | ~~Deprecated~~ |
| Task Lists | `- [x] Done` | [x] Operational |

> **Blockquote Demonstration**
>
> "Blockquotes support full formatting: *italic quotes*, ~~obsolete remarks~~, and task lists:
